t: This is the site of 1 Undershaft, a skyscraper planned for the City of London's financial district. It is designed by Eric Parry Architects and would replace the St Helen's tower. At 309.6 metres above ordnance datum, it would be the second-tallest building in the United Kingdom after the Shard, though standing on higher ground it would look the same height on the skyline. Eric Parry founded his practice in London in 1983, and his work includes the restoration of St Martin-in-the-Fields.
